rv.t: 공 가지고 노는 액션 대전 게임 우리가 알던 대전 게임과 다르게 기술 콤보 다 필요 없다 그냥 공만 잘 가지고 놀면 끝
물리 스포츠 게임. 캠페인 어느 정도 깨고 마무리. 온라인 한 번 해보려 했으나 매칭이 잡히지 않았다! 하지만 캠페인 할 때 만이라도 익사이팅함을 좀 느낄 수 있었다.
Amazing game, needs more players though. Unfortunately friends hate playing with me on it, but that's on them. They still have to hear candyman's laugh every time they go to sleep

Lethal League Blaze is great for inviting a few of the boys over and blasting the ball around. The hype that happens every time the ball is hit over a certain speed is so simple, but it still works! …

I cannot recommend this game. I know it's an old game with old netcode, but when I can play games of a similar age with lower than triple-digit ping from coast to coast, I really can't feel like I can appreciate and learn the game.
好玩！！跟朋友一起玩很杀时间很快乐，平常也可以跟电脑玩玩，除了我是游戏低手一直被电脑暴打（。） 美术十分有特色音乐更是强的可怕，角色的设计也都很有趣！！最喜欢Jet嘿嘿 没话说了总之Team Reptile牛逼。
好玩 机制简单又纯粹 同时不缺乏深度
